why: Three things change. The circles in the box go 0, 1, 2, 3, so next there are 4. The black corner goes bottom-right, bottom-left, top-left, top-right, so it comes back to bottom-right. The star goes top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, so it comes back to top-left. Option 3 has all three. Options 1 and 4 have only 3 circles.
trick: Use counting first (0,1,2,3 means 4 next); it quickly removes most options.
